title: dacryodes macrophylla

The bioactive constituents present in Dacryodes macrophylla include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and its ability to modulate the immune system.
